sees: frame 1: A gray-flapped envelope labeled SECRET on the left and a row of ten solid black person icons labeled SOCIETY on the right, on a pale panel over a sunburst background; badge 'INSIGHT 2 / 2' top left, 'RED RISING' top right.

frame 2: The envelope turns bright orange with an orange circle around it; a curved gray arrow runs from the envelope to the people row. Only the first person icon is solid black, the other nine are dotted outlines.
frame 3: Same as frame 2: orange envelope with circle, arrow pointing to the people row, one solid person and nine dotted outlines.
changed: The envelope went from gray to orange and highlighted, an arrow appeared from it to the society group, and nine of the ten people turned from solid to dotted outlines, leaving one solid.
cause: The secret (envelope) acting on or being directed at society, shown by the arrow.
effect: Most of society is erased, faded or absent, with only one person left solid; it is unclear whether this means the secret is known by only one person, or that society is removed or hollowed out.
message: A secret, once it is activated or spread, affects society so that only one person remains who knows it (or is real) while the rest fade away.
wouldConfuse: The dotted outlines are ambiguous: they could mean people who do not know the secret, people erased, or people not yet told. The arrow direction and the single solid figure do not clearly say which.
